_readme: Compatibility contract of each reference starter kit: the one problem it implements (problemTypes), the neighbouring problems whose reusable parts can be adapted with named changes (adaptable), what it provides on each dimension, and what it cannot represent. The generator matches a use case's problem profile against these contracts; a kit that is not listed for the use case's problem type is never silently substituted. Edit this file, not the generator, to change what a kit claims. 'caveats' name sub-structures a kit does not implement: when a use case's own text matches a caveat pattern, the matching dimension is marked 'adapt' with the change shown, so a kit for the same problem is not called an exact match for a structurally different one.

multiclass-classification: Replace the binary delayed label with the use case's class label, and score with macro-F1 and per-class precision and recall instead of PR-AUC at a fixed false-positive rate
Replace the calibrated logistic baseline and boosted challenger with multi-class versions (one-vs-rest or softmax) and calibrate per class
Keep the chronological split, the label-maturity rule and the point-in-time leakage test unchanged
regression-estimation: Replace the binary label with the continuous target and the loss with the use case's error measure (for example absolute or squared error, or a quantile loss)
Replace PR-AUC and recall at a fixed false-positive rate with error metrics and interval coverage, reported by segment
Replace the calibrated logistic baseline with the use case's baseline (a linear or generalised linear model, or a rule) and the boosted classifier with a boosted regressor
Keep the chronological split, the point-in-time features and the leakage test unchanged

provides.label: A binary outcome confirmed after a delay (a positive 7 to 21 days later; a negative only after the full maturity window)
provides.validation: Chronological split with entity separation and a label-maturity rule; leakage test on every feature
provides.metrics: PR-AUC and recall at a fixed false-positive rate, plus calibration
provides.data: Event-level rows with point-in-time windowed features and group fan-out features
provides.model: Calibrated logistic regression baseline against a regularised gradient-boosted challenger
provides.serving: Offline scripts only: no scoring service, deadline, feature store or load test
provides.integrations: None. Runs locally on synthetic card-authorisation data with pandas and scikit-learn
provides.vocabulary: Card authorisations, cards, merchants, devices, mule devices, chargebacks and fraud

reusable: Chronological, entity-safe split with a label-maturity rule
Point-in-time feature builders and the leakage test
Calibrated baseline versus boosted challenger comparison
Recall at a fixed false-positive rate
cannotRepresent: Ranking within a group or a query
Text, images or graph structure as the primary input

provides.label: The observed value h days after a forecast origin, divided by the series' recent average at the origin, so one model serves every series
provides.validation: Rolling forecast origins with origin-safe features and late-arriving feeds
provides.metrics: Weighted absolute percentage error by horizon, forecast value added against a seasonal baseline and prediction-band coverage
provides.data: Many daily series with calendar effects, planned events, censored demand (stock-outs) and late feeds
provides.model: Seasonal baseline against quantile gradient boosting
provides.serving: Offline backtest scripts only: no scheduled pipeline, publishing or reconciliation
provides.integrations: None. Runs locally on synthetic retail-style demand
provides.vocabulary: Series, SKUs, stores, promotions, stock-outs and demand

reusable: Forecast value added against a seasonal baseline
Handling of censored demand and late feeds

caveats.change: The kit forecasts daily series: change the granularity, calendar features and horizons to hourly or intraday
The kit forecasts a series; this use case predicts a per-shipment or per-order quantity with an interval, so change the unit of prediction and its features
Add hierarchical reconciliation, cold-start or intermittent-demand handling, which the kit does not implement

tabular-anomaly-detection: Replace the seasonal metric series with the entity-level feature stream the use case scores, and define the anomaly interval for it
Replace the seasonal residual and calendar features with the use case's behavioural features and their baselines
Keep the alert budget, the detection-delay measure and the no-future test unchanged

provides.label: A point is anomalous when it lies inside a known anomaly interval; an event is detected when an alert fires inside it (or shortly after)
provides.validation: Chronological evaluation with a fixed alert budget and no-future features
provides.metrics: Recall, detection delay and false alerts per series per week at a fixed alert budget
provides.data: Operational metric series with daily and weekly seasonality, level shifts, drift and calendar effects
provides.model: Rolling z-score, robust seasonal baseline and a calendar-aware version
provides.serving: Offline scripts only: no streaming scorer, alert routing or suppression service
provides.integrations: None. Runs locally on synthetic operational metrics
provides.vocabulary: Metric series, seasonal residuals, alerts and incidents

cannotRepresent: Forecasting with prediction bands as the product

caveats.change: The kit scores single metric series: define the entity stream this use case scores (sessions, hosts, containers or logs) and its features

personalised-ranking: Replace leave-last-out next-click evaluation with the use case's own relevance signal (purchase, conversion, engagement or profit-weighted outcome) and its time split
Add user and context features, and a candidate-generation stage if the catalogue is too large to score in full
Keep the bot and dwell filtering, the time split and the coverage measurement unchanged
search-ranking: Add a query: the kit has none, so add query-product retrieval (lexical and semantic) before the ranker and index the catalogue
Replace next-click labels with graded relevance from human judgements or position-debiased click logs, and evaluate with NDCG on those judgements
Add multi-objective ranking (relevance, conversion, margin, sponsored or business rules) and a debiasing method for position
Keep the time split, the bot filtering and the coverage measurement unchanged

provides.label: No separate label: for each test session the prefix of clicks is the input and the final click is the target (leave-last-out)
provides.validation: Time split by session with a leave-last-out protocol; sessions under three clicks are skipped
provides.metrics: Hit rate at 20, mean reciprocal rank and catalogue coverage
provides.data: Anonymous browsing sessions of item clicks, with dwell time and bot traffic
provides.model: Popularity, co-visitation, ordered transitions and a theme-aware model
provides.serving: Offline evaluation only: no retrieval index, session store, re-ranker or latency path
provides.integrations: None. Runs locally on synthetic sessions
provides.vocabulary: Sessions, items, clicks, dwell time and bots

reusable: Hit rate, MRR and coverage measurement

graph-analytics: Replace pair labels (same real-world group) with the use case's own target on nodes, edges or clusters, and its evaluation (for example cluster purity against analyst groupings)
Replace shared-attribute blocking with the graph the use case really has (transactions, accounts, hosts, services) and its construction rules
Keep the transitivity test, the hub and cluster-size checks and the split that separates groups

provides.label: A pair of records is positive when both belong to the same hidden true cluster; clusters are connected components over the pairs the model links
provides.validation: Group-separated split with blocking and transitivity tests and a check on the largest cluster
provides.metrics: Pair precision and recall, with the size of the largest cluster
provides.data: Records with shared attributes (names, devices, addresses) that link them into groups
provides.model: Rarity-weighted pair features with a pair classifier, clustered by connected components
provides.serving: Offline scripts only: no incremental linking service or merge workflow
provides.integrations: None. Runs locally on synthetic records
provides.vocabulary: Records, shared attributes, hubs, groups and clusters

reusable: Connected-component clustering with a cluster-size check
cannotRepresent: Node classification on a transaction graph

information-extraction: Replace the document label with span or field labels, and score field-level or entity-level precision, recall and F1 instead of document macro-F1
Replace TF-IDF with logistic regression by a tagger or extractor suited to spans (a sequence model or a rule-plus-model hybrid)
Keep the thread-grouped split, the leak-token filter and the drift check unchanged

provides.label: The class of the whole document, assigned by the person who handled it; documents in one thread share a label
provides.validation: Time and thread-grouped split with a post-hoc leak-token filter and a vocabulary-drift alarm
provides.metrics: Honest macro-F1 compared with the optimistic number
provides.data: A text corpus of tickets or documents with duplicate threads and vocabulary drift
provides.serving: Offline scripts only: no inference service, queue routing or human-handoff path
provides.integrations: None. Runs locally on synthetic text
provides.vocabulary: Tickets, documents, threads, topics and leak tokens

vision-detection-segmentation: Replace image-level labels with box or mask annotations, and score mAP, IoU or Dice, and per-finding sensitivity, instead of per-image AUC
Replace pooled local-contrast features with a detector or segmentation model fine-tuned on the use case's images
Keep the split by physical item, the lighting-shortcut check and the site-shift threshold carry-over

provides.label: An image is positive when it contains the finding (a defect, a lesion, a tampered region); labels are per image and images of one item share a group
provides.validation: Split by physical item with a shortcut test and a site-to-site operating-threshold check
provides.metrics: AUC and false-alarm rate at a fixed threshold across sites
provides.data: Small synthetic images with a lighting shortcut and two capture sites
provides.model: Pixel baseline against pooled local-contrast features
provides.serving: Offline scripts only: no camera ingest, edge runtime or latency path
provides.integrations: None. Runs locally on generated images
provides.vocabulary: Images, items, defects, sites and lighting

uplift-causal-effect: Replace the single reward with the use case's outcome and treat the action as treatment versus control, with the assignment probability logged
Replace the policy-value estimators with an uplift learner and score with Qini or AUUC on a randomised holdout, keeping the inverse-propensity check as a sanity test
Keep the logged propensities and the estimator-error measurement against a known true effect

provides.label: The reward is 1 if the chosen action succeeded and 0 otherwise; only the chosen action's reward is observed and its selection probability is logged
provides.validation: Logged decisions with propensities; offline estimators compared with the hidden true value of each policy
provides.metrics: Policy value and the error of four off-policy estimators
provides.data: Logged context, action, propensity and reward rows
provides.model: A reward model and a learned policy against the best constant action
provides.serving: Offline scripts only: no decision service, exploration controller or live experiment
provides.integrations: None. Runs locally on synthetic logged decisions
provides.vocabulary: Contexts, actions, propensities, rewards and policies

reusable: Comparison of estimates with a known true value

provides.label: The quantity to minimise is realised total cost; predictions are inputs only and the plan is scored against true costs, with the optimal plan under true costs as the reference
provides.validation: Instances with known true costs; regret against the oracle and the gap between promised and realised cost
provides.metrics: Realised cost, regret against the oracle and optimism of the promise
provides.data: Assignment instances with predicted costs, uncertainty and hard constraints
provides.model: Greedy assignment, optimal assignment on predictions and optimal assignment with an uncertainty penalty
provides.serving: Offline scripts only: no scheduled planner, re-optimisation trigger or plan publication
provides.integrations: None. Runs locally on synthetic assignment instances

cannotRepresent: Simulation of a network over time

caveats.change: Add route and time-window structure: the kit assigns items one at a time and has no routes, sequences or travel times. Replace the assignment solver with a routing solver and score tours, not assignments
Add the scheduling structure the kit does not model (time slots, precedence, capacity over time) and score the schedule against true durations
Add the multi-period, multi-resource structure (inventory, packing or network flow) that the kit's one-shot assignment lacks

grounded-generation: Replace answer-value correctness with the use case's output measure (for example faithfulness, unsupported-statement rate or figure exact match) and a golden set of the documents it must produce
Keep the verifier that requires the cited passage to support each claim, and extend it to every generated statement rather than a single value
Add the output template or structure the use case requires, with review before release

provides.label: Each golden question carries the expected value for the right document version, or none when the documents never state it; correct means the expected value or an abstention
provides.validation: Golden set with unanswerable questions held out by product, and a verifier that checks the cited passage
provides.metrics: Answer accuracy, hallucination on unanswerable questions and abstention rate
provides.data: A versioned document collection with chunks, source types and intents
provides.model: Hybrid retrieval, a source filter, an intent check and a verifier, with a deterministic stand-in for the language model
provides.serving: Offline harness only: no document ingestion, vector store, model gateway or answer API
provides.integrations: None. A deterministic stand-in replaces the model; no provider or index is connected
provides.vocabulary: Documents, versions, passages, questions and citations

agentic-write-actions: Replace the scripted planner with a model-driven planner behind the same typed tool interface and step budget

Add the product operations the use case must perform as typed write tools, authorised on behalf of the signed-in user with that user's own permissions, and keep the approval token in front of every write
Add execution verification: read the system state back after each write, confirm the intended change happened, and reverse it (or compensate) when it did not
Extend the replay set with write scenarios, partial failures and permission denials, and keep the planted-instruction tests

provides.label: Every case carries a verdict and the evidence lines that decide it; correct means the verdict matches, every claim cites a real supporting line and the agent escalates when the deciding lines are unavailable
provides.validation: Replay set with planted instructions, tool outages and missing evidence; permission and approval tests
provides.metrics: Verdict accuracy, injection success, unsafe actions and honest escalation
provides.data: Replayed investigation cases with evidence lines and untrusted fields
provides.model: A scripted planner with typed read-only tools, an approval gate for writes and a claim verifier, with a deterministic stand-in for the language model
provides.serving: Offline harness only: no agent runtime, queue, identity or tool gateway
provides.integrations: None. Read-only tools over synthetic cases; the approval token is simulated and no real system is written to
provides.vocabulary: Cases, evidence lines, tools, verdicts, approvals and indicators

reusable: Typed tool interface and step budget
Approval token in front of writes
cannotRepresent: Execution verification and reversal of writes
